intro.title: BRIDGING PERCEPTION AND SPATIAL REASONING
intro.subtitle: About
intro.description: **I aspire to develop AI that mirrors human perception and judgment.** My work focuses on **spatial reasoning**: enabling models to infer *where* objects are and how they relate, not merely *what* they are. I approach this through **camera-based 3D perception** and **vision-language models**. I care about how systems behave when their inputs are degraded or ambiguous. I am drawn to problems where existing methods break down, and I prefer to understand why they fail before proposing alternatives.

values.title: Working from Fundamentals
values.description: I prioritize **root causes** over surface symptoms. When my object masking module degraded ViewFormer's performance, I traced it to **unstable mask supervision** rather than accepting the negative result—and found the same architecture **outperformed the baseline** under single-GPU training.

values.title: Strategic Tenacity
values.description: I tend to immerse myself deeply in a single problem, which can narrow my perspective. To mitigate this, I set **time-boxed checkpoints** and review code with **lab colleagues**. This keeps my persistence from turning into stubbornness.

values.title: Pragmatic Innovation
values.description: I aim for robust technologies capable of navigating **real-world edge cases**, not just algorithms that work in a controlled lab. I try to keep **theoretical rigor** and **practical feasibility** in balance.

cards.title: Hardware-Aware AI
cards.description: I possess an in-depth understanding of automotive hardware mechanisms alongside software proficiency. My hands-on experience with high-voltage EV systems and vehicle maintenance shapes how I approach **On-Device AI**. I validated RDT on a **single RTX 3090** using a **7B VLM** in place of the original 72B model, adding only 2.4GB of VRAM.

cards.title: Team Leadership
cards.description: Serving as the team leader of an autonomous driving organization, I adapted my approach to each member’s unique capabilities and motivations. I led by example and cultivated a **culture of collective growth** by mentoring and studying alongside those needing technical support, and we completed the project together.

cards.title: Robust Logic Design
cards.description: I prioritize **algorithms that stay reliable when inputs degrade** over purely theoretical ideals. My experience in developing fail-safe logic—specifically detecting wrong-way driving relative to the centerline to address edge cases of lane occlusion—reflects how I approach safety-critical components.

steps.title: Mechanical Understanding and Intellectual Curiosity
steps.description: I built the foundations of automotive systems by assembling vehicle chassis in an undergraduate student-built vehicle organization. This experience allowed me to understand cars not just as moving vehicles, but as complex **systems where hardware and software are organically integrated**.

steps.title: Witnessing the Potential of Autonomous Driving
steps.description: Experiencing Tesla's **early autonomous driving** technology firsthand convinced me of the potential of vision-centric perception. By analyzing how technologies previously confined to research papers translate into real-world decision-making and control on actual roads, I became convinced that the future of AI depends on how well machines perceive **space**, not just objects.

steps.title: Proactive Leadership and Collaborative Execution
steps.description: I founded S.D.S, a student autonomous driving team. Serving as the Vision Team Leader, I developed core algorithms for **Lane Detection** and **Traffic Sign Recognition**, while cultivating practical expertise in anticipating potential failure modes and engineering **robust safety logic**.

steps.title: Advancing into Scholarly Depth
steps.description: Driven by a commitment to solving complex, real-world challenges, I pursued graduate studies to immerse myself in State-of-the-Art (SOTA) research. I began with **model lightweighting** on **UniAD**, then designed an **Object Mask Module** for **ViewFormer** to strengthen object representation in **BEV space**—a negative result I traced to **unstable mask supervision** under distributed training. Building on this, I proposed **Relational Depth Text (RDT)**, which improves zero-shot 3D visual grounding by **3.54%p** on Nr3D while running on a **7B VLM**, roughly ten times smaller than the original model.

vision.title: Future Vision: Making Spatial Reasoning Reliable
vision.description: My next step is to make **spatial reasoning** reliable enough to act on. Current vision-language models describe scenes well but still fail on relative depth and occlusion—the exact gap my work on **depth-aware grounding** addresses. I want to close it before moving toward **Vision-Language-Action (VLA)** models. My ultimate goal is to engineer foundational systems that empower not only the automotive sector but also robotics and AI agents to navigate and act within the world with human-like intuition.
